title: Casper and the Border
author: Odile Vasquez
blurb: Oscar Sterling, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
